capabilities: Highlight PDF text as standard /Highlight annotations with selectable colors
Attach and remove notes stored in the annotation's /Contents field
List all highlights and notes with deep links back to each annotation
Export highlights and notes into a Markdown note beside the PDF via a re-synced block
Sync note-carrying highlights into flashcard notes for spaced repetition
extras: The README warns that the plugin rewrites PDF files in place (keep backups) and patches an internal PDF viewer method, which Obsidian updates can break; it fails loudly rather than silently misbehaving.
intentEvidence: Highlight text and take notes in PDFs from inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer only reads annotations and stores plugin data outside the file, so highlights and notes made in Obsidian don't travel with the PDF to other readers.

relations.evidence: obsidian-spaced-repetition stores that inline, on the line after the card
the PDF is fully re-serialized on every save (that's how pdf-lib works)

summary: PDF annotation plugin that writes standard highlights and notes into the PDF file itself and syncs them to spaced-repetition flashcards.
